prompts.name: loot-ambush
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one cinematic widescreen 16:9 background illustration for Bare, a Rust-style full-loot survival game. The subject MUST be recognizably Rust-style geared adult player survivors looting after a skirmish, NOT a running unarmed civilian. Two grounded, rugged survivors with believable Rust improvised equipment: one in a worn yellow hazmat suit with red hood, black gas-mask visor, blue rubber gloves, dirty boots, an AK-pattern rifle slung securely across the back, kneeling to take ammunition and components from an open canvas loot backpack; beside them a lookout in a faded red hoodie, crude metal face mask, road-sign chest armor and road-sign kilt over work trousers, carrying a clearly visible makeshift AK-style rifle in both hands. Both have realistic sturdy proportions, weathered fabric and scrap gear. Loot includes rifle magazines, metal components, cloth bundles; a downed backpack and dropped weapon, no gore. Rocky conifer frontier beside a small player-built stone and corrugated-metal base, distant mountains, a huge faint moon, dusk amber rim lighting and cold blue atmospheric depth. Rust promotional-render aesthetic, realistic game art, physically grounded materials, no generic military operators, no sleek space armor, no random woman jogging. CRITICAL WEBSITE COMPOSITION: a text panel will overlay the LEFT 53 percent. Keep that entire left region dark, low-detail, empty rocky foreground and soft tree shadows. Place BOTH armed survivors, their complete silhouettes, all visible guns and the loot interaction entirely inside the RIGHT 40 percent, between x=60% and x=95%, y=12% and y=90%. The right-side group is a readable medium-wide action vignette, no clipping at any edge. Environment continues seamlessly across whole frame; do NOT draw a UI panel, text, logo, watermark or border. This is one full-bleed scenic image designed around negative space, not a split layout.

prompts.name: orbital-flight-layout
prompts.prompt: Edit the reference artwork for a cinematic 16:9 full-bleed website hero background. Preserve exactly the IronWake large industrial gunship and the little Tin Finch designs, materials, distinct cockpits, engines, planetary horizon, blue/amber palette and filmic realistic style. Recompose the SAME scene for a headline on the LEFT: both entire ships, including every engine, cannon barrel, cockpit and Tin Finch, must be grouped inside x=55% to x=93% of the frame, y=20% to y=80%. Large ship is the main focal subject in the right half, Tin Finch just below-left of it but still right of x=55%. Leave the LEFT 48% as naturally dark deep space and faint atmospheric cloud glow without important objects. Keep a convincing three-dimensional orbital perspective and heroic scale, preserve the beautiful sunlit planet. No typographic panel, no UI, no text or logos, no collage or picture-in-picture. One seamless scenic background. The hero copy will be HTML later; do not draw it.

prompts.name: orbital-strike-layout
prompts.prompt: Edit the reference into an immersive cinematic widescreen 16:9 website hero, preserving the exact IronWake ship design and a Rust-style player-built stone and corrugated-sheet-metal fortified base. Critical action invariant: ONLY the giant paired forward main orbital cannons on the nose fire, with both muzzle flashes originating at their barrel tips; all small side defensive turrets and upper secondary battery remain idle. Recompose to place the COMPLETE ship at upper right x=57%-94%, y=15%-49%, aimed diagonally down toward the COMPLETE smaller base at lower right x=61%-87%, y=65%-89%. Both glowing projectile trails from nose to target remain wholly in the RIGHT 45% of the image. The LEFT 50% must be dark open atmospheric sky and low-detail ocean/clouds, reserved for a website headline, with no important subject or muzzle trail crossing it. Ship above the curved planetary horizon, vast high-altitude perspective, worn gray industrial hull, rust-orange trim, exposed cylindrical engines, sunset amber light, blue-black space. The base is a player-built modular stone/sheet metal stronghold with wall layers and simple wind turbines, not a futuristic installation. Keep the whole ship and target inside the canvas, no cropped edges. No people or gore. No UI, letters, title, drawn text panel or watermark.

prompts.name: frontier-landing-layout
prompts.prompt: Recompose this same atmospheric 16:9 frontier scene into a full-bleed website background designed for a LEFT text overlay. Preserve the exact Tin Finch small rusted sheet-metal ship design, landing skids, glass canopy, side cylinders, and the Rust-style player-built stone block/sheet metal base; preserve blue mountain dusk, huge moon and warm practical light. ALL main content must occupy the RIGHT 43%: complete small player base and its lit doorway in the far right background x=73%-96%; complete Tin Finch at x=59%-88%, y=43%-77%; two armed Rust-style geared adult survivors unload metal crates beside it in that same right region. Use road-sign armor, hoodies/work pants and slung rifles rather than generic unarmed hikers. The LEFT 52% is naturally dark low-detail rocky ground and atmospheric woodland/mountain silhouette, with no important building, ship, people, or cargo. Entire scene has coherent wide-angle perspective and appropriate scale; no part of the Tin Finch is cut off. Do not make a futuristic industrial installation or wooden log cabin. No typography, no UI, no picture-in-picture or separate panels, no watermark.

selection_notes: The first loot prompt produced a rejected Rust-costume variant. Do not publish it. Use bare-loot.webp and art-prompts-v9.json. The three ship layout variants were selected.
